title: Denmark: Several wounded in suspected gang shooting
facts: Three people were wounded in a shooting in Denmark on Sunday, August 9, 2026.
Danish police confirmed that none of the three shooting victims suffered life-threatening injuries.
Danish police stated they believe the shooting was connected to a settling of scores within criminal networks.
Police officers were dispatched to multiple locations in Holbaek, Denmark.
Holbaek is located approximately 70 kilometers west of Copenhagen.
The shooting incident was reported to emergency services around 3:45 p.m. local time.
A fight broke out within a group of people in a residential estate prior to the gunfire.
Witnesses reported seeing the shooting suspects flee the scene in a white car.
The shooting occurred in a residential area of Holbaek.
Danish authorities initiated an investigation into the suspected gang-related altercation.
Police units secured multiple sites across Holbaek in response to the incident.
The three injured individuals received medical treatment following the attack.
The armed confrontation involved a large group in the residential neighborhood.
Danish law enforcement actively pursued the occupants of the white getaway vehicle.
The shooting incident in Holbaek took place during the afternoon hours of August 9, 2026.
